label: Supply edge: partial co-ground or sufficient supply
term: supply edge of the closed-collection Profile
resolution: The Profile edge m.grounds used by CCR (aca3baa1-9be6-4720-a53d-22050e638561), borrowed reality (45890c84-1d33-4273-b0ea-0f75bfd67a33), supplier concreteness and the ConcreteRootAccess batch is neutral: every registered theorem there holds whichever sense an edge takes, and no statement selects one. The localized bridge (a485166e-4868-4a0f-b017-ab095c16e202) demands root access for every concrete recipient with any actual nonconcrete supplier, whatever the sense. The two senses matter for the rival comparison only. The motivation 'harmless abstract co-grounds' reads an abstract edge as SUPPLY_EDGE_1: the abstract supplier does not select existence, so a concrete network it constrains is assessed as a pure concrete network against borrowed reality. The mixed realization-law rival reads it as SUPPLY_EDGE_2: under CONCRETE_6 a nonconcrete sufficient supplier of esse owes an account of supplying esse without esse in re (docs/notes/esse-root-leaves.md, (f) row 6). No argument passes from one sense to the other; the senses exclude each other constructively and cover every actual edge only under explicit excluded middle (ConcreteRootAccess.partial_or_sufficient).
